tools.name: ChatPRD
tools.description: AI copilot designed specifically for product managers and their teams to draft complete Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), one-pagers, roadmaps, and more with just a few prompts.
bullets: ProductCentric AI: Built specifically for PM roles—ChatPRD understands product processes and document standards.
OnDemand CPO Feedback: Acts like a virtual Chief Product Officer, offering real-time coaching and critique as you work.

tools.name: Wisary
tools.description: AI-powered collaboration app embedded in Confluence, designed to help product leaders and teams align across remote or scaling environments, guiding the creation of clear PRDs.
bullets: InConfluence, No Context Switching: AI works where documents already live—no new tools needed.
Intelligent Prompts to Avoid Gaps: The AI asks clarifying questions to fill blind spots in PRDs.

tools.name: Write My PRD
tools.description: AI-driven assistant powered by ChatGPT/GPT-3, designed to simplify and accelerate the creation of Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).
bullets: ChatGPT-Prompt Engineered: Tailored prompts and formatting optimized for PRD generation—saves time versus writing in vanilla chat interfaces
User-Friendly Interface: Clean, intuitive design guides users through each section

tools.name: GetBash PRD Generator
tools.description: AI-powered solution designed to streamline the creation of Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) by accepting diverse input formats such as competitor URLs, product pages, meeting notes, and audio recordings.
bullets: MultiSource Intelligence: Generates PRDs from diverse inputs—text, webpages, or even audio—for comprehensive documentation
TemplateDriven Speed: Speedsters past blankpage paralysis using a tried-and-tested PRD template
